description: This file is a Python script implementing a linter for verifying proper usage of versioned shim functions in PyTorch source code. It extracts function versions from header files, checks code files for correct macro wrapping around function calls, and outputs lint messages.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration of severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: Data structure representing a lint message with details such as location, code, severity, and description.

methods.name: get_shim_functions
methods.description: Extracts versioned shim function names and their required versions from header files.

methods.name: write_shim_function_versions
methods.description: Writes the list of shim functions and their versions to a text file.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Checks a source file for proper usage of versioned shim functions and returns lint messages.
